$comment: The v0.1.11 baseline (YAZ-2073 1A/1B, re-measured in 7A) every YAZ-2073 change compares to. Built from 51e85cd in its own worktree (`npm ci` + `npm run desktop:build`) and measured on one machine with this branch's tools: `npm run perf:budget -- --app … --dmg … --out …` for size, and `npm run perf -- <scenario> --runs 7 --app <yaz-2073-speed build> --vs <this build>` for speed — the two apps interleaved run by run (ABBA), one warm-up each discarded, the 7 measured runs listed with the median, the nearest-rank p95 and cv (stdev / mean). The machine was shared with other agents (1-minute load 29–159; loadAvg is the load before → after each scenario, both apps together), which the interleaving spreads over both apps alike. Compare a change against a fresh run of this app on the same machine, not against these numbers from another one.
